rows.label: Warm model and pipelines, fresh uncached prompts, final K=4/flush-32 stack under ORCA
rows.statistic: Median of six rotating paired observations; each observation resets KV state and uses a different prompt.

pairedSpeedup.baseline: published WebLLM 0.2.84 runtime and subgroup-32 model library, one-step sampler
pairedSpeedup.candidate: local subgroup-32/chunk-256/TR=32 model library, K=4, one compute pass, submit every 32 dispatches

quality.freshPromptExact: 6/6 tuned outputs byte-identical to the paired published path with equal completion-token counts
quality.qualityCorpusExact: 4/4 tuned outputs byte-identical to local K=1 full-vocabulary argmax; published temperature-zero sampler was nondeterministic on the math item

rows.notes: 21.65 ms/token is the reciprocal of the measured 46.19 tokens/s median. The paired 1.187x statistic is the median of per-round ratios and need not equal the ratio of independent medians.

publishedBaseUnderOrcaSmoke.notes: Single warm smoke, recorded for completeness; not the paired baseline.

publishedSubgroup32UnderOrca.notes: Paired six-round published WebLLM 0.2.84 subgroup-32 baseline under ORCA.

caveat: Absolute measured throughput was taken while ORCA saturated the CPU. The paired ratio is the robust headline. There is no historical quiet 8B number and no quiet projection is claimed.
